text:
sam_support: fyi we just got an urgent escalation from ACME — multiple customers hitting p99 spikes (6-12s) on Dedicated pool during their nightly batch window :boom:
leo_sre: saw the alert, investigating. p95 up ~2s, p99 jumped to ~8s for a subset of requests. looks correlated with a ~50% increase in attach requests to the customer's reserved pool at 02:00 UTC
eva_platform: do we have queue/backpressure traces for that window? can we see attach rate vs slot provisioning times? :eyes:
maria_eng: grabbing logs now. preliminary: many attach requests queued and then a flurry of pod startups, image pulls + GPU init happened in parallel. a bunch of cold-GPU startups overlapped -> long tail
sam_support: customer says it only started last week after they increased parallel clients from 20 -> 200 for a nightly job
leo_sre: that matches. looks like a thundering herd at scaleup time. provisioner created N pods but warmup scheduling wasn't staggered so K8s pulled images concurrently. some nodes throttled image-pulls leading to 10-30s warmup tails
eva_platform: interesting — we also saw a spike in scheduling latency and container runtime logs show repeated CRI backoffs during that window
leo_sre: repro plan: simulate N clients firing attach concurrently to the pool and measure p99. simple script below to mimic attachment pattern:
```
# repro.sh
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/attach -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"pool_id":"acme-reserved"}' &
done
wait
```
Run from multiple processes to simulate 1k parallel attach requests.
maria_eng: i ran a smaller repro in staging (200 parallel) and reproduced p99 ~7-9s with clear correlation to image pulls. when i set min_pool=10 (prewarmed slots) the tail mostly disappeared (p99 ~1s)
sam_support: customer asked if there's a short-term mitigation we can apply right away
eva_platform: short term: bump min_prewarmed for that org to 10-20 depending on their commit. also throttle their attach concurrency via per-org token limit. medium term: we should implement randomized warmup splay and staggered image pull/attach sequencing so not all pods init at once
leo_sre: added a quick playbook: 1) increase min_pool for ACME to 15, 2) enable per-token attach rate limiter at 50/sec, 3) enable fallback to smaller model variant for heavy batch jobs, 4) monitor p99 & queue depth for 2 hours
maria_eng: pulled a heatmap of pool attach times during repro — attaching it to the ticket. also found a small bug: warmup hooks run concurrently in our init container, they don't check a shared lock so every pod runs the full model cache init at once
eva_platform: that bug explains duplicate heavy IO. plan: add leader-election for warmup cache init in initContainer, and add randomized backoff before heavy cache download (100-1000ms * jitter factor)
leo_sre: deployment notes for fix: - change init hook to leader election (k8s Lease) - add jittered delay in init container - add controller-level splay for node attachments (configurable) - expose org-level min_prewarm override in console
sam_support: can we ship the mitigation as a config flip first (min_prewarm + rate limit) and then roll the init lock later? customer prefers fast mitigation
eva_platform: yes, we can flip config per-org quickly. I'll schedule a small maintenance change. will coordinate with infra to ensure no restart is required
maria_eng: repro steps and logs I used:
```
# run 4 clients in parallel from 4 hosts (~800 concurrent)
./repro.sh &
# capture attach times
kubectl logs deployment/provisioner -n redwood | grep "attach_time_ms" > repro-attach.log
```
results: median 120ms, p95 900ms, p99 7200ms without prewarm. with min_prewarm=15 -> p99 ~ 900ms
leo_sre: short checklist for support -> apply now for ACME:
- set org.min_prewarm=15 (console / API)
- set org.attach_qps_limit=50
- enable smaller-model fallback for nightly job (if they opt-in)
- watch metrics: pool.queue_depth, attach_latency_p99, image_pull_wait_s
sam_support: putting customer on those mitigations now, i'll update ticket and ask them to retest tonight. thanks team :pray:
eva_platform: follow-up actions (owner tags):
- eva_platform: flip org prewarm & qps limit (today)
- maria_eng: prepare initContainer leader-election patch & unit tests (next week)
- leo_sre: add controller splay config + rollout plan (next sprint)
- sam_support: confirm customer regressions resolved and collect post-change p99 graphs
oncall-bot: reminder: create postmortem if p99 > 5s again in next 72h (link: https://pm.redwood/internal/incidents/3587654321)
leo_sre: noted. also adding a temporary alert suppression for noisy image-pull errors while we flip configs to avoid alert storms
sam_support: thanks everyone — i'll close the loop with ACME once nightly run completes and paste results here
